summary: Iteration 13 e2e review of SocietyHub: tanker Booking/Delivery dates (validation + delivery-month filing + reserve inflow), flat opening/outstanding dues with payer flowing into 'Bal brought forward', the two label renames, floor->flat ordering everywhere, click-to-sort headings on every report/entry table, and the new month-end owner pack (GET /api/reports/pack pdf|png|zip). Backend: 29 new pytest cases (28 pass, 1 fail) in test_iter13_booking_dues_pack.py + test_iter13_colours.py; regression suites iter9/iter10/iter11/iter12/auth_playbook pass after updating their stale column expectations. Frontend: 4 Playwright runs across Login, Water, Setup, Reconciliation, MIS, Charges, Dashboard/Overview/Annual and rentals Property Reports — all pack downloads (13 files) succeed, all sort headings toggle, dues/payer and Paid-by columns render correctly. Only one real defect found: the reconciliation table in the pack PDF overflows the right page edge.

minor.issue: Reconciliation section table is wider than the printable area: right edge x=844.5pt on a 841.9pt landscape A4 page (12mm margin limit 807.9pt). The last 'Status' column bleeds past the page edge / margin, so it is clipped when printed and looks cut in the WhatsApp PNG. Reduce font/col widths for that 16-column table or set explicit colWidths. Reproduced by tests/test_iter13_booking_dues_pack.py::TestReportPack::test_nothing_clipped

No page break between the cover page and the first report: 'Water usage charges' starts on the cover page and its Summary/Colour-key block spills onto page 2; the 'Water reconciliation' heading is orphaned on page 3 while its table sits on page 4. Consider PageBreak between sections.
Tanker Purchases sheet title merge uses span=12 while the table now has 13 columns (Booking + Delivery added) — the title no longer spans the whole table. Cosmetic.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Flat No.' and 'Floor' headings share sortKey 'floor', so two elements carry the same data-testid (reconcile-sort-floor / mis-sort-floor / meters-sort-floor) and there is no independent sort by flat number. Duplicate testids make strict selectors ambiguous.

issues: Delivery-before-booking is blocked only by the native browser bubble ('Value must be 08/10/2026 or earlier') because the booking input carries max=delivery; the friendly backend message 'Delivery date must be on or after the booking date' is never shown. Works, but an inline app-styled error would be consistent with the rest of the app.
Two 401 console errors on first paint from the pre-login /api/auth/me probe — noise only, no functional impact.

action_items: Fix the reconciliation table width in reports.py so the Status column stays inside the 12mm right margin (page 4 of the combined pack, and the standalone reconciliation PDF/PNG).
Optional: add PageBreak between the cover and each report section so every report starts on its own page and headings are not orphaned.
Optional: give the 'Flat No.' heading its own sortKey (e.g. flat_number) so the two headings do not share one data-testid.
Optional: widen the xlsx Tanker Purchases title merge from span=12 to 13.
critical_code_review_comments: engine.compute_statement: carry fallback `carry_in[fid] if fid in carry_in else flat.opening_dues` is correct and verified — after POST /api/periods/reset the next month's carry_in equals the closed month's net (no double counting) and carry_in_payer is blanked.

server.tanker_doc: month is derived from the delivery date for both POST and PUT and validation raises 400 before any write — verified. guard_open is called for both the old and the new month on PUT, good.
reports.py build_sections rebuilds a fresh Palette per call, so owner/meter colours are stable and identical between the single-report and combined PDFs (verified by pixel sampling).
server.py is 1407 lines — the MIS/annual/pack export builders should move into their own module (reports/xlsx already exist) to keep files under ~700 lines.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iter10_recon_layout.py (stale expectations updated: 16 columns, 'Advance payment paid by', new 'Paid by' column index)
/app/backend/tests/test_iter11_xlsx_export.py (stale expectations updated: recon 16 headers, Tanker sheet Booking/Delivery columns and shifted payer columns)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (pack downloads, sorting, dues, renames)

seed_data_creation: Temporary only, all removed: flat TEST902 (dues 5000 by tenant) on Sunrise Residency via UI, flat TEST901 + tankers TEST_ok/TEST_crossmonth via API, scratch property 'TEST_ZZ Dues Property' for the month-close test. Verified DB has no leftover TEST flats/tankers/properties. Pre-existing scratch rentals rows (TEST_Carry f91e11, QA Prop *) from earlier iterations remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified this round: POST/PUT /api/tankers reject delivery<booking with 400 and file the purchase under the DELIVERY month (litres/reserve move to that month); flat opening_dues + opening_dues_payer reach statement rows as carry_in/carry_in_payer and satisfy net = base + carry - advance - paid; /api/periods/reset does not double count opening dues; GET /api/flats, statement rows and meters are floor->flat sorted; /api/reports/pack pdf/png/zip (9 files in zip) with 400s for bad format/report; per-owner and per-meter colours unique and stable across single vs combined PDFs (pixel sampled); MIS csv/pdf/xlsx carry 'Advance payment paid by' + 'Paid by' and the xlsx Tanker sheet has Booking/Delivery. NOTE: MIS csv/pdf exports have no tanker table by design (xlsx only). Known harness quirks: running the whole /app/backend/tests folder with the configured -n 2 xdist causes cross-suite interference in the rentals suites (test_iter6 shares a scratch property across classes) — run rentals files with -n 0. test_iter6_rentals_rebuild.py::TestBills::test_draft_prefilled_from_master is stale (expects 42500, gets 85000 because rentals carry-forward from iter7 now adds the prior unpaid month) — left untouched for the developer to confirm intent.
rca_of_the_issue: reports.py::build_sections builds the reconciliation table with 16 columns and no explicit colWidths, letting reportlab auto-size to 844.5pt on a 841.9pt landscape A4 page; the Table is hAlign=LEFT inside a 12mm-margin frame, so the overflow is not centred but pushed off the right edge, clipping the Status column in both the PDF and the rasterised WhatsApp PNG. Fix: pass explicit colWidths summing to <= 817.9-24 pt (or drop FONTSIZE to ~6.5 and shorten headers) for the reconciliation section only.
